table.retrieve:
select 
	aliasname=item.customicode,
	itemname=item.name,
	itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=item.icatcode),
	model=item.modeldescription,
	color=(select name from itemcolour where item.icolourcode=itemcolour.icolourcode),
	color2=(select name from itemcolour where item.itemcolourcode2=itemcolour.icolourcode),
	itemthickness=(select name from itemthickness where item.itemthicknesscode=itemthickness.itemthicknesscode),
	itemthickness2=(select name from itemthickness where item.itemthicknesscode2=itemthickness.itemthicknesscode),
	thickness=item.thickness,
	remarks=item.remarks,
	length=item.length,
	width=item.width,
	areavolume = item.areavolume,
	purprice=item.purprice,
	saleprice=item.saleprice,
	saleprice2=item.saleprice2,
	saleprice3=item.saleprice3

from item

where item.icatcode in (:aa_catcode) 
	
order by itemcategory,
		    itemname
